title: Data schema
text: Each `data/<kind>/<lane>.json` and `data/concepts.json` is `{"schema_version": 1, "lane": "<lane>", "records": [...]}`. `data/observed.json` is keyed by record id and written only by `tools/enrich.py`.

title: Data schema
text: An id is `<kind>:<slug>`. The slug matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$` and has no `//`, no `__` and no trailing `/`. The page path replaces `/` in the slug with `__`: `tool:remotion-dev/remotion` => `catalog/tool/remotion-dev__remotion.md`.

title: Data schema
text:
File: `data/schema/record.schema.json`. One record in data/<kind>/<lane>.json. The id is <kind>:<slug>. Fields shared by all kinds are listed here; allOf adds the fields each kind requires.

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | `^(tool\|model\|source\|recipe):[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$` | Stable id, <kind>:<slug>. Never reused. |
| `kind` | string | yes | tool, model, source, recipe | - |
| `title` | string | yes | - | Exact name. |
| `aliases` | array of string |  | - | Old names and abbreviations, indexed by search. |
| `url` | string |  | `^https?://` | Canonical URL. |
| `summary` | string | yes | - | 1-3 sentences in our own words: what it is. |
| `why_it_matters` | string | yes | - | 1-2 sentences for this hub's reader. |
| `concepts` | array of string | yes | `^concept:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | Ids from data/concepts.json. |
| `level` | string | yes | intro, intermediate, advanced | - |
| `maturity` | string |  | experimental, active, established, dormant, shut-down | - |
| `fit` | string | yes | high, medium, low | Judged against the reader's job. |
| `fit_notes` | string | yes | - | Concrete way to use it. Cost, gotchas. Something a search result would not say. |
| `related` | array of object |  | - | - |
| `related[].id` | string | yes | `^(tool\|model\|source\|recipe):[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$` | - |
| `related[].rel` | string | yes | depends_on, integrates_with, alternative_to, extends, evaluated_on, supersedes, contradicts | - |
| `related[].note` | string |  | - | - |
| `source_type` | string | yes | primary, independent-secondary, vendor-or-author, community, aggregator, unknown | - |
| `corroboration` | string | yes | confirmed-by-independent-source, single-source, contested, cannot-judge | - |
| `claims` | array of object | yes | - | - |
| `claims[].text` | string | yes | - | Our sentence. |
| `claims[].quote` | string | yes | - | Verbatim source words. |
| `claims[].locator` | string | yes | - | Where in the source, for example sec 4.2, table 3. |
| `claims[].url` | string | yes | `^https?://` | - |
| `claims[].retrieved` | string | yes | `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$` | - |
| `claims[].via` | string or null |  | - | The secondary source, when the original was not opened. Blocks the quoted-primary tier. |
| `checked` | object | yes | - | - |
| `checked.date` | string | yes | `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$` | Changes only when someone actually checks. |
| `checked.depth` | string | yes | primary-read, skim, not-checked | - |
| `checked.by` | string | yes | `^(human\|agent\|process):[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$` | - |
| `checked.what` | string |  | - | What was compared with what. |
| `checked.source_sha256` | string |  | `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | sha256 of the saved source the claims were checked against. |
| `checked.next_due` | string | yes | `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$` | From review_interval_days in hub.config.json. |
| `status` | string | yes | current, disputed, outdated, archived, retracted | - |
| `status_note` | string |  | - | Why, and the date. |
| `superseded_by` | string or null |  | `^(tool\|model\|source\|recipe):[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$` | - |
| `archive_url` | string or null |  | `^https?://` | - |
| `url_status` | string | yes | live, dead, moved | - |
| `lane` | string |  | - | Research lane that wrote it. The data file carries it too. |
| `tags` | array of string |  | `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | Free and secondary. The build reports tags used once. |
| `licence_override` | string |  | - | Hand override of the collected licence. |
| `licence_reason` | string |  | - | - |
| `citation` | object |  | - | - |
| `citation.type` | string |  | - | - |
| `citation.author` | array of string |  | - | - |
| `citation.issued` | string |  | - | - |
| `citation.container_title` | string |  | - | - |
| `citation.doi` | string |  | - | - |
| `citation.url` | string |  | `^https?://` | - |
| `citation.accessed` | string |  | `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$` | - |
| `measured` | object |  | - | Set only when this hub measured it. Gives the measured tier. |
| `measured.rung` | string | yes | agent-run, scripted-run, static-read | - |
| `measured.command` | string | yes | - | - |
| `measured.input` | string | yes | - | - |
| `measured.commit` | string | yes | - | - |
| `measured.result` | string |  | - | - |
| `measured.example` | string |  | - | examples/<name> that holds the run. |
| `downgrade` | object |  | - | One-step badge downgrade with a named reason. |
| `downgrade.reason` | string | yes | indirect, inconsistent, tiny-sample, interested-party | - |
| `downgrade.note` | string |  | - | - |
| `tool_type` | string |  | skill, plugin, mcp-server, renderer, library, framework, runtime, service, app | - |
| `agents` | array of string |  | claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, hermes, any-skill, any-mcp, none-stated | - |
| `levers` | array of string |  | motion, design, story, consistency, audio, captions, review-loop, delivery, gen-model-craft, asset, orchestration, publishing | - |
| `cost` | string |  | free-local, free-tier, paid, mixed, not-checked | - |
| `modes` | array of string |  | t2v, i2v, v2v, edit, lipsync, t2i, i2i, tts, music, stt, upscale | - |
| `access` | string |  | api, weights, app-only, shut-down | - |
| `apple_silicon` | string |  | measured-by-us, documented, no-documented-path, not-checked | - |
| `licence_class` | string |  | permissive, commercial-threshold, non-commercial, territory-restricted, proprietary, unknown | - |
| `stages` | array of object |  | - | Ordered stages of a recipe. |
| `stages[].stage` | string | yes | - | - |
| `stages[].record_id` | string | yes | `^(tool\|model\|source\|recipe):[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/-]*$` | - |
| `stages[].note` | string |  | - | - |
| `video_types` | array of string |  | explainer, reel, product-demo, ad, short-film, music-video, diagram, screencast | - |

title: Data schema
text:
File: `data/schema/concept.schema.json`. One vocabulary entry in data/concepts.json. SKOS ideas in plain JSON. The id never changes; the label may. At most 2 broader concepts. A concept has no licence.

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | `^concept:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | - |
| `label` | string | yes | - | Preferred label. |
| `alt_labels` | array of string |  | - | Synonyms and acronyms, shown and indexed. |
| `hidden_labels` | array of string |  | - | Misspellings and reader slang, indexed only. |
| `scope_note` | string |  | - | What is in and what is out. |
| `broader` | array of string |  | `^concept:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | Parent concepts, at most 2. |
| `related` | array of string |  | `^concept:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` | - |
| `same_as` | string or null |  | `^https?://` | - |

File: `data/schema/example.schema.json`. examples/<name>/example.json. The threshold is fixed before the run.

| Field | Type | Required | Allowed | Notes |

| `title` | string |  | - | - |

title: Data schema
text:
Required on top of the shared fields, per `kind`:

| Kind | Also required |
|---|---|
| tool | `url`, `maturity`, `tool_type`, `agents`, `levers`, `cost` |
| model | `url`, `maturity`, `modes`, `access`, `apple_silicon`, `licence_class` |
| source | `url` |
| recipe | `maturity`, `stages`, `video_types` |

A record is marked inactive when `status` is archived or retracted, or `maturity` or `access` is shut-down. It keeps its page and is listed separately in the catalog.

title: Data schema
text:
One badge per record, derived in this order; the first row that applies wins.

| Tier | Label | When |
|---|---|---|
| `measured` | measured by us | `measured.rung` is one of `measured_rungs` in hub.config.json and `measured.command`, `measured.input`, `measured.commit` are set |
| `quoted-primary` | quoted, primary source read | at least one claim, `checked.depth` is primary-read, no claim has `via`, `source_type` is primary, independent-secondary, vendor-or-author, and `corroboration` is not contested |
| `quoted-secondary` | quoted, not read at the primary source | at least one claim and `checked.depth` is primary-read or skim, but a quoted-primary condition fails; the reasons name which |
| `unverified` | unverified | everything else: no claims, or `checked.depth` is not-checked |

A `downgrade` with a named reason (indirect, inconsistent, tiny-sample, interested-party) moves the badge one tier down. A dead or moved link adds a reason and keeps the tier.
